title: Dutch Wrap with Manchego and Crunchy Slaw
description: A tasty and easy wrap filled with the flavors of the Netherlands, featuring a crunchy slaw and melted Manchego cheese.
instructions: 1. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
2. Season the chicken breast with salt and pepper.
3. Grill the chicken for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
4. Meanwhile, toast the wrap on the grill or in a toaster.
5. Slice the grilled chicken into thin strips.
6. Assemble the wrap by spreading the Dutch mustard on the wrap, followed by the sliced chicken, Manchego cheese, and crunchy slaw.
8. To make the crunchy slaw, mix 1 cup of shredded cabbage with 2 tbsp of mayonnaise and 1 tsp of apple cider vinegar.
9. Season the slaw with salt and pepper to taste.
10. Refrigerate the slaw for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
